text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh~? I thought we were supposed to meet 
around here... Have they not arrived yet?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Pajama party supply shopping squad, we've 
got the right meeting spot... right~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you statues on grocery duty too? 
In that case, should we head out first~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I bet my besties could totally hype up the 
Goddess Statue and get partyin' together 
too!
